text:
nina Quick ping: Vendor Atlas replied — they can lend 2 H100s in eu-west3 for ~30h starting tomorrow morning. Low-QPS perf sweep. Can we greenlight? Need infra + finance OK. @cory any infra concerns? :wave:
cory Which pool would these attach to? Any disk mounts?
nina Pool: staging-inference, ephemeral only. No mounts; use eu S3 bucket. Residency okay for test data.
vendor-bot Atlas allocation ETA: ~18h. Ticket AT-7712. Allocation is time-limited and requires a short vendor acknowledgement + purchase token if over $900.
zack I can open the infra PR and set single-az eu-west3-b to reduce variance. Will add healthcheck.
procure-bot Heads-up: vendor token required for any allocation > $900. Please fill token request: https://procure.internal/atlas/token-request?ticket=AT-7712
finance Can approve one-off vendor token if cost center + cap provided. Need NTE or GPU-hour estimate.
nina Estimate: 2 GPUs * 6h + 3h buffer = 18 GPU-hours. Vendor rate ~ $40/hr => ~$720. Request cap $1k. Cost center: cc-221. Approver: @finance.
finance Approved up to $1k, conditional on auto-shutdown at 12h and telemetry to `canary/staging` dashboard. :white_check_mark:
sre Please attach tail-latency trace and notify if p95 regresses >20%. Also prefer a readiness probe that fails fast after 5m.
zack Draft PR snippet (will open in a min): ```resource "redwood_alloc" "atlas_canary_euw3" {  pool = "staging-inference"  gpu = "h100"  count = 2  window = "2026-07-11T06:00Z/2026-07-11T18:00Z"  labels = { az = "eu-west3-b", run = "atlas-canary" }  owner = "zack"}```
cory Ops note: include `nodeStartupTimeout=5m` in the PR and a fallback to local dev-l40s pool if atlas cancels. Also tag `monitoring=canary/staging`.
nina Will add nodeStartupTimeout + fallback. If vendor cancels, we'll fall back to 1 l40s and run a trimmed sweep.
procure-bot Token request link: https://procure.internal/atlas/token-request?ticket=AT-7712 — tagging @finance to expedite.
finance I'll file the token and queue payment on PR reference to cost center + cap. Expect token in ~6-8h after PR reference.
zack PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/3456  assigned to @cory for infra review and @finance for billing sign-off. I added smoke test that fails on node join >5m.
nina Thanks team  once PR + token confirmed, I'll kick the canary and post a one-liner in #incidents if we see regressions. Closing loop after run. :rocket:
